open_points.subject: start-up recovery of a run containing both ready and still-waiting elements
open_points.text: “A run derived `running` is advanced with `runs`' own advance, which reaches every ready element while other elements still wait (A13 rule 8) …; a run derived still waiting is not advanced”
open_points.question: When at least one element remains waiting but another element has become ready, does recovery derive the run as `running` and advance the ready element, or derive the status as `awaiting_approval`/`pending` because a wait remains and perform no advancement?
options: Derive `running` whenever any element is ready and advance all ready work before storing a waiting status
Derive `awaiting_approval` or `pending` whenever any wait remains and do not advance during recovery
open_points.default_guess: Derive `running` while any element is ready, advance it despite other waits, then store the final waiting status.
open_points.unit: 30_modules.md:Facts several modules touch, and their one owner

open_points.subject: recovery treatment of a decided effect approval
open_points.text: “an element whose approval was decided, or whose attempt the owner resolved `not_applied`, is not reached and so is ready”
open_points.question: Does “approval was decided” mean only an approved approval, or also a refused approval, which A10 rule 3 says has already written `refused_by_owner` and must end the run `refused` rather than make the element ready?
options: Only an approved approval makes an otherwise unconcluded element ready
Both approved and refused approvals make the element ready
Approval status is ignored here and readiness is determined solely from the element's NodeExecution and approval records
open_points.default_guess: Treat only an approved approval without a concluding NodeExecution as making the element ready; a refused approval remains concluded `refused_by_owner`.
